title: Seetha concerned about Sri Rama's vow to kill demons
introduction: Seetha foresees danger in Rama's decision to eliminate the demons in Dandaka forest, without any provocation from their side, at the request of some sages. She narrates an old episode about a sage who in possession of a weapon became violent and cruel.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे नवमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 9th chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
सुतीक्ष्णेन अभ्यनुज्ञातम् प्रस्थितम् रघु नन्दनम् |
हृद्यया स्निग्धया वाचा भर्तारम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sutīkṣṇena abhyanujñātam prasthitam raghu nandanam |
hṛdyayā snigdhayā vācā bhartāram idam abravīt
verses.translation: To Rama, the scion of Raghu and her husband, who started out when permitted by Sage Suteekshna, Vaidehi spoke this with friendly words.
notes: Seetha addresses Rama with this percept. "Wielding weaponry you are entering into an area where the demons are dense, and you intolerantly embark to kill them, thereupon we two get separated, which in turn is intolerable to you. So let us leave weapons back at hermitage and go to forests to see sages - Govindaraja. "The promise made to sages in eradicating demons is himsātmaka, injurious; they can be won over by ahimsa, non-injurious methods also. None can avert Rama to make a promise, nor ask him to deviate from it. Aware of this stubbornness of Rama, her heart felt a foreboding, and that love-blind Seetha started telling in a friendlily manner, in view of her friendship with Rama, that may disrupt soon.

glosses.meaning: who started, to her husband, to Raghu's, son, Rama

verses.devanagari:
अधर्मम् तु सुसूक्ष्मेण विधिना प्राप्यते महान् |
निवृत्तेन च शक्यो अयम् व्यसनात् कामजाद् इह
verses.iast:
adharmam tu susūkṣmeṇa vidhinā prāpyate mahān |
nivṛttena ca śakyo ayam vyasanāt kāmajād iha
verses.translation: "Gross unjust will accrue to any in an abstruse way if his indulgence is enkindled merely by his own desire, and in this world it is possible to fend them off, to have a recourse to justness...
notes: For the first word adharma of Gorakhpur version, there are other words available in other mms like yastu dharmam tu and ayam dharma . The critical editions and also Dharmaakuutam puts it as ayam dharmaḥ susūksmeṇa vidhinā prāpyate mahān... Instead of adharma, ayam dharma is there, which changes the negative attitude to positive Then this ayam dharmaḥ translates as 'this dharma, the duty of a prince, which you are going to take-up in the wake of promise given to sages, i.e., killing demons, without a valid reason, that which is righteous to you, can be performed in a different way...'

glosses.meaning: in this world, it is possible
to one who fends it off.

verses.devanagari:
त्रीणि एव व्यसनानि अत्र कामजानि भवन्ति उत |
मिथ्या वाक्यम् तु परमम् तस्मात् गुरुतरा उभौ
पर दार अभिगमनम् विना वैरम् च रौद्रता |
verses.iast:
trīṇi eva vyasanāni atra kāmajāni bhavanti uta |
mithyā vākyam tu paramam tasmāt gurutarā ubhau
para dāra abhigamanam vinā vairam ca raudratā |
verses.translation: "Only three self-gratifications, the definite products of desire, are there: one is speaking fallacious utterances, which itself is worse, and worst than the other two malefic self-gratifications, where the other two are the fascination for other's wife, and the cruelness without enmity...
notes: Seetha is foretelling the triggering points in the course of Ramayana. The addictions or self-gratifying acts are defined as:

glosses.meaning: desire produced, self-gratifications, are three, only
than, from the two above, weighty [worst.]

verses.devanagari:
मिथ्या वाक्यम् न ते भूतम् न भविष्यति राघव
कुतो अभिलषणम् स्त्रीणाम् परेषाम् धर्म नाशनम् |
verses.iast:
mithyā vākyam na te bhūtam na bhaviṣyati rāghava
kuto abhilaṣaṇam strīṇām pareṣām dharma nāśanam |
verses.translation: "The habit of telling specious words is not there with you in the past nor it will be there in future, oh, Raghava, then wherefrom the virtue-ruining desire for other's women can be there...

glosses.meaning: fallacious, [habit of ] telling, not, to you, it was there
nor, it will be in future
wherefrom [it will be there to you.]

verses.devanagari:
तव नास्ति मनुष्येन्द्र न च आभूत् ते कदाचन
मनस्यपि तथा राम न च एतत् विद्यते क्वचित् |
स्व दार निरतः च एव नित्यम् एव नृपात्मज
verses.iast:
tava nāsti manuṣyendra na ca ābhūt te kadācana
manasyapi tathā rāma na ca etat vidyate kvacit |
sva dāra nirataḥ ca eva nityam eva nṛpātmaja
verses.translation: "Oh, king, earlier this vile desire for other's women is absent in you, nor it is there now, unobserved is such a desire in any corner of your heart oh, prince, for you are always interested in your own wife...

glosses.meaning: in you, not, is there [so far]

glosses.itrans: tathaa manasi api kvachit na vidyate
glosses.iast: tathā manasi api kvacit na vidyate
glosses.devanagari: तथा मनसि अपि क्वचित् न विद्यते
glosses.meaning: like that, [in any corner] of your heart, even, not, observable

glosses.itrans: nitym eva sva daara nirataH ca
glosses.iast: nitym eva sva dāra nirataḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: नित्य्ं एव स्व दार निरतः च
glosses.meaning: always, thus, in your own, wife, interested, alone.

verses.devanagari:
धर्मिष्टः सत्य सन्धः च पितुः निर्देश कारकः |
त्वयि धर्मः च सत्यम् च त्वयि सर्वम् प्रतिष्टितम्
verses.iast:
dharmiṣṭaḥ satya sandhaḥ ca pituḥ nirdeśa kārakaḥ |
tvayi dharmaḥ ca satyam ca tvayi sarvam pratiṣṭitam
verses.translation: "You are conscientious, adherent of truth, and obliging father's orders, and in you virtue and truth, nay everything is established in you...

glosses.meaning: in you, is virtue, truth, also

verses.devanagari:
तच्च सर्वम् महाबाहो शक्यम् वोढुम् जितेइन्द्रियैः |
तव वश्य इन्द्रियत्वम् च जानामि शुभदर्शन
verses.iast:
tacca sarvam mahābāho śakyam voḍhum jiteindriyaiḥ |
tava vaśya indriyatvam ca jānāmi śubhadarśana
verses.translation: "Oh, dextrous one, all this can possibly be shouldered by one with controlled senses, and oh, graceful one for a gaze, I am also aware of your sense control...
notes: The compound mahābāhośakyam is also cleaved as mahā bāho a + śakyam, meaning that 'your attributes are impossible to be known even by the self-controlled sages, but they are known to me...' so says Seetha.

verses.devanagari:
तृतीयम् यद् इदम् रौद्रम् पर प्राण अभिहिंसनम् |
निर्वैरम् क्रियते मोहात् तत् च ते समुपस्थितम्
verses.iast:
tṛtīyam yad idam raudram para prāṇa abhihiṃsanam |
nir.hvairam kriyate mohāt tat ca te samupasthitam
verses.translation: "That third tendency to torture others' lives without enmity, that which will usually be effectuated unwarily, has now suddenly chanced before you...

glosses.meaning: that, even, the third [tendency,] to you, [suddenly] chanced before you.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिज्ञातः त्वया वीर दण्डकारण्य वासिनाम् |
ऋषीणाम् रक्षणार्थाय वधः संयति रक्षसाम्
verses.iast:
pratijñātaḥ tvayā vīra daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinām |
ṛṣīṇām rakṣaṇārthāya vadhaḥ saṃyati rakṣasām
verses.translation: "Intending to safeguard the sages you have promised the dwellers in Dandaka forest, oh, valiant one, that you would eliminate demons in a fight...

glosses.meaning: in a fight, of demons, elimination

verses.devanagari:
एतन् निमित्तम् च वनम् दण्डका इति विश्रुतम् |
प्रस्थितः त्वम् सह भ्रात्रा धृत बाण शराअसनः
verses.iast:
etan nimittam ca vanam daṇḍakā iti viśrutam |
prasthitaḥ tvam saha bhrātrā dhṛta bāṇa śarāasanaḥ
verses.translation: "Only in this respect you have started towards the well-known Dandaka forest along with your brother, and wielding bow and arrows...

verses.devanagari:
ततः त्वाम् प्रस्थितम् दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्त आकुलम् मनः |
त्वत् वृत्तम् चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेत् निःश्रेयसम् हितम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ tvām prasthitam dṛṣṭvā mama cinta ākulam manaḥ |
tvat vṛttam cintayantyā vai bhavet niḥśreyasam hitam
verses.translation: "Then on seeing your starting my mind is apprehensively upset, on verily reflecting about your bearing there appears to be no beneficial good for you...
notes: This last compound of second foot where nisḥ śreyasam hitam is available in Gorakhpur version. In Eastern version it is bhaven niḥśreyasam hi tat and in other older scripts it is: tvām caiva prasthitam dṛṣṭvā rāma cintāluma manaḥ | sarvataḥ cintayantyā me tava niḥśreyasam nṛpa || Dharmaakuutam puts this wording as: niḥśreyasam mahat. It is similar in critical editions also bhaven niḥśreyasaṃ hitam Dharmaakuutam defines this expression as, anena bhartṛu hitakāriṇyā bhāryayā śreyo bhavatīti sūcitam || In any way, Seetha's contemplation is, "you abide by your oath given to sages, and thus kill the demons. But without a cause you do not proceed to eliminate. If a cause for quarrel is to be there, that will be due to me. If I become the cause and depart you, you cannot survive without me, for you are not a polygamist. So how all these factors like your promise, monogamy, and eliminating demons, can be resolved by you? Thus I am thinking along with the associated troubles which you are going to undergo..."

glosses.meaning: then, you, on starting, on seeing
my, mind, with apprehension, is upset

verses.devanagari:
न हि मे रोचते वीरः गमनम् दण्डकान् प्रति |
कारणम् तत्र वक्ष्यामि वदन्त्याः श्रूयताम् मम
verses.iast:
na hi me rocate vīraḥ gamanam daṇḍakān prati |
kāraṇam tatra vakṣyāmi vadantyāḥ śrūyatām mama
verses.translation: "Oh, brave one, your going towards Dandaka forest is not delightful to me, I tell the cause for that and listen to it as I tell...

glosses.itrans: dandakaan prati gamanam na hi me rocate
glosses.iast: dandakān prati gamanam na hi me rocate
glosses.devanagari: दन्दकान् प्रति गमनं न हि मे रोचते
glosses.meaning: Dandaka, towards, going, not, verily, to me, delightful
cause, in that respect, I tell
as I tell, you may listen, of my [talk.]

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् हि बाण धनुष्पाणिः भ्रात्रा सह वनम् गतः |
दृष्ट्वा वन चरान् सर्वान् कच्चित् कुर्याः शर व्ययम्
verses.iast:
tvam hi bāṇa dhanuṣpāṇiḥ bhrātrā saha vanam gataḥ |
dṛṣṭvā vana carān sarvān kaccit kuryāḥ śara vyayam
verses.translation: "Indeed on entering the forest along with your brother, and wielding bow and arrows, seeing the forest ramblers there, won't you deplete arrows on all of them...

verses.devanagari:
क्षत्रियाणाम् इह धनुर् हुताशस्य इन्धनानि च |
समीपतः स्थितम् तेजो बलम् उच्छ्ह्रयते भृशम्
verses.iast:
kṣatriyāṇām iha dhanur hutāśasya indhanāni ca |
samīpataḥ sthitam tejo balam ucchhrayate bhṛśam
verses.translation: "The bow of warrior and the fuel of a burning fire if available within their reach, they immensely enhance their strength...

glosses.meaning: in within the reach, available, bow

verses.devanagari:
पुरा किल महाबाहो तपस्वी सत्य वाक् शुचिः |
कस्मिन् चित् अभवत् पुण्ये वने रत मृग द्विजे
verses.iast:
purā kila mahābāho tapasvī satya vāk śuciḥ |
kasmin cit abhavat puṇye vane rata mṛga dvije
verses.translation: "Once upon a time, oh, dextrous one, there was a pious and true worded hermit in some merited forest that was wonted by animals and birds...

glosses.meaning: in a merited [forest,] wonted by, animals, birds

glosses.itrans: satya vaak shuciH tapasvii abhavat kila
glosses.iast: satya vāk śuciḥ tapasvī abhavat kila
glosses.devanagari: सत्य वाक् शुचिः तपस्वी अभवत् किल
glosses.meaning: true, worded, pious, sage, was there, indeed.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य एव तपसो विघ्नम् कर्तुम् इन्द्रः शचीपतिः |
खड्ग पाणिः अथ आगच्छ्हत् आश्रमम् भट रूप धृक्
verses.iast:
tasya eva tapaso vighnam kartum indraḥ śacīpatiḥ |
khaḍga pāṇiḥ atha āgacchhat āśramam bhaṭa rūpa dhṛk
verses.translation: "Then Indra came to that hermitage handling a sword, and donning a soldier's guise, to cause hindrance to that hermit's ascesis...

glosses.meaning: his, that, ascesis, hindrance, to cause

verses.devanagari:
तस्मिन् तत् आश्रम पदे निहितः खड्ग उत्तमः |
स न्यास विधिना दत्तः पुण्ये तपसि तिष्ठतः
verses.iast:
tasmin tat āśrama pade nihitaḥ khaḍga uttamaḥ |
sa nyāsa vidhinā dattaḥ puṇye tapasi tiṣṭhataḥ
verses.translation: "Indra gave that best sword to store, there in that hermitage to that sage who is lasting in his ascesis, on a redeemable basis...

glosses.meaning: in ascesis, to sage, one lasting in
he, that best, sword, kept with sage
in a redeemable, basis, it is given.

verses.devanagari:
स तत् शस्त्रम् अनुप्राप्य न्यास रक्षण तत्परः |
वने तु विचरति एव रक्षन् प्रत्ययम् आत्मनः
verses.iast:
sa tat śastram anuprāpya nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ |
vane tu vicarati eva rakṣan pratyayam ātmanaḥ
verses.translation: "On receiving that sword, he who is duteous in guarding the entrustment, moved about in the forest always handling the sword, to safeguard the confidence reposed in him...

glosses.meaning: to safeguard, confidence reposed, in him

verses.devanagari:
यत्र गच्छ्हति उपादातुम् मूलानि च फलानि च |
न विना याति तम् खड्गम् न्यास रक्षण तत्परः
verses.iast:
yatra gacchhati upādātum mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
na vinā yāti tam khaḍgam nyāsa rakṣaṇa tatparaḥ
verses.translation: "Wherever that dedicated guardian of that entrustment goes, even to obtain tubers or fruits, he did not go without that sword...

glosses.meaning: entrustment, to guard, one who is dedicated to
to obtain, tubers, even, fruits, too

verses.devanagari:
नित्यम् शस्त्रम् परिवहन् क्रमेण स तपोधनः |
चकार रौद्रीम् स्वाम् बुद्धिम् त्यक्त्वा तपसि निश्चयम्
verses.iast:
nityam śastram parivahan krameṇa sa tapodhanaḥ |
cakāra raudrīm svām buddhim tyak{}tvā tapasi niścayam
verses.translation: "Carrying that sword always, that hermit slowly made his own faculty infuriated, loosing determination in ascesis...

glosses.meaning: he, [by ascesis rich one] that hermit

verses.devanagari:
ततः स रौद्र अभिरतः प्रमत्तो अधर्म कर्षितः |
तस्य शस्त्रस्य संवासात् जगाम नरकम् मुनिः
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa raudra abhirataḥ pramatto adharma karṣitaḥ |
tasya śastrasya saṃvāsāt jagāma narakam muniḥ
verses.translation: "Then with the constant association of that weapon that sage gradually became inadvertent, and smitten by vice he went to hell...

verses.devanagari:
एवम् एतत् पुरा वृत्तम् शस्त्र संयोग कारणम् |
अग्नि संयोगवत् हेतुः शस्त्र संयोग उच्यते
verses.iast:
evam etat purā vṛttam śastra saṃyoga kāraṇam |
agni saṃyogavat hetuḥ śastra saṃyoga ucyate
verses.translation: "Thus, all this happened earlier, only owing the reason of associating with a weapon constantly, and the sequel of constant association with weapon is as good as constant association with fire...

glosses.meaning: by weapon's, [constant] association, reason of - falling in to hell

verses.devanagari:
स्नेहात् च बहुमानात् च स्मारये त्वाम् न शिक्षये |
न कथंचन सा कार्या गृहीत धनुषा त्वया
बुद्धिः वैरम् विना हन्तुम् राक्षसान् दण्डक आश्रितान् |
अपराधम् विना हन्तुम् लोको वीर न कामये
verses.iast:
snehāt ca bahumānāt ca smāraye tvām na śikṣaye |
na kathañcana sā kāryā gṛhīta dhanuṣā tvayā
buddhiḥ vairam vinā hantum rākṣasān daṇḍaka āśritān |
aparādham vinā hantum loko vīra na kāmaye
verses.translation: "In affinity and in respect I am reminding but not tutoring you, and in anyway improper is that thought of yours to wield your bow to kill the demons dwelling in Dandaka without any enmity, oh, brave one, undesirable is the killing of offenceless...

verses.devanagari:
क्षत्रियाणाम् तु वीराणाम् वनेषु नियतात्मनाम् |
धनुषा कार्यम् एतावत् आर्तानाम् अभिरक्षणम्
verses.iast:
kṣatriyāṇām tu vīrāṇām vaneṣu niyatātmanām |
dhanuṣā kāryam etāvat ārtānām abhirakṣaṇam
verses.translation: "For the valiant Kshatriya-s who are inclined in forests heartily, the purpose of the bow is this much 'safeguarding the sufferers...'
notes: There are some conflicting reviews on this stanza. It is said in the first foot vaneṣu niyata ātmānām But older mms contain sva dharmeṣu nirata ātmānām will be found, while Dharmaakuutam and Eastern versions have it as vaneṣu nirata only. This Gorakhpur version and critical editions are having as vaneṣu niyata The meaning in other versions is that Kshatriya-s should delight in their class-oriented righteousness, even when in forests. Thus Seetha's thinking is that they should live like hermits in forests, without resorting to the warring attributes of Kshatriya class. In the second foot she says that the function of bow is limited to 'safeguard the suffering lot...' In the next chapter at 3-10-3, Rama retorts with the same expression in answering Seetha.

glosses.meaning: in forests, who are inclined, heartily

verses.devanagari:
क्व च शस्त्रम् क्व च वनम् क्व च क्षात्रम् तपः क्व च |
व्याविद्धम् इदम् अस्माभिः देश धर्मः तु पूज्यताम्
verses.iast:
kva ca śastram kva ca vanam kva ca kṣātram tapaḥ kva ca |
vyāviddham idam asmābhiḥ deśa dharmaḥ tu pūjyatām
verses.translation: "Where that weapon? Where this forest? Where the principles of Kshatriya? And where is sageness? All this is inconsistent... let us esteem the laws of the land...

verses.devanagari:
तदार्य कलुषा बुद्धिः जायते शस्त्र सेवनात् |
पुनर् गत्वात् तत् अयोध्यायाम् क्षत्र धर्मम् चरिष्यसि
verses.iast:
tadārya kaluṣā buddhiḥ jāyate śastra sevanāt |
punar gatvāt tat ayodhyāyām kṣatra dharmam cariṣyasi
verses.translation: "Weapon admiring mind becomes maligned with avariciousness, you may therefore follow the tenet of Kshatriya-s on going to Ayodhya again...

glosses.meaning: mind, with avariciousness, maligned, it becomes

verses.devanagari:
अक्षया तु भवेत् प्रीतिः श्वश्रू श्वशुरयोः मम |
यदि राज्यम् हि संन्यस्य भवेत् त्वम् निरतो मुनिः
verses.iast:
akṣayā tu bhavet prītiḥ śvaśrū śvaśurayoḥ mama |
yadi rājyam hi saṃnyasya bhavet tvam nirato muniḥ
verses.translation: "Everlasting satisfaction will be there to my father-in-law and mothers-in-laws, on your becoming a devout sage even after forfeiture of kingdom...

verses.devanagari:
धर्मात् अर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात् प्रभवते सुखम् |
धर्मेण लभते सर्वम् धर्म सारम् इदम् जगत्
verses.iast:
dharmāt arthaḥ prabhavati dharmāt prabhavate sukham |
dharmeṇa labhate sarvam dharma sāram idam jagat
verses.translation: "From virtuousness prosperity emanates, from righteousness happiness, and by honourableness all are achieved, and this universe is the essence of probity...

verses.devanagari:
आत्मानम् नियमैः तैः तैः कर्षयित्वा प्रयत्नतः |
प्राप्यते निपुणैः धर्मो न सुखात् लभते सुखम्
verses.iast:
ātmānam niyamaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ karṣayitvā prayatnataḥ |
prāpyate nipuṇaiḥ dharmo na sukhāt labhate sukham
verses.translation: "Experts will make efforts to exhaust their own selves with those and those principles, thus they realise sublimity... unachievable is pleasure by pleasuring alone...

glosses.meaning: not, by pleasuring, achievable, is pleasure.

verses.devanagari:
नित्यम् शुचि मतिः सौम्य चर धर्मम् तपो वने |
सर्वम् हि विदितम् तुभ्यम् त्रैलोक्यम् अपि तत्त्वतः
verses.iast:
nityam śuci matiḥ saumya cara dharmam tapo vane |
sarvam hi viditam tubhyam trailokyam api tattvataḥ
verses.translation: "Always tread along the righteousness with a pure mind, oh, gentle one, and specially in these sagely forests... you know everything in all the three worlds, in all its nuances...

glosses.meaning: to you, in its nuances, known.

verses.devanagari:
स्त्री चापलात् एतत् उदाहृतम् मे
धर्मम् च वक्तुम् तव कः समर्थः |
विचार्य बुद्ध्या तु सह अनुजेन
यत् रोचते तत् कुरु म अचिरेण
verses.iast:
strī cāpalāt etat udāhṛtam me
dharmam ca vak{}tum tava kaḥ samarthaḥ |
vicārya buddhyā tu saha anujena
yat rocate tat kuru ma acireṇa
verses.translation: "I cite all this with my womanly waver, and who is capable to talk to you about dharma? Ponder mindfully along with your brother, and what that is appropriate, you do it...but not belatedly...

glosses.meaning: women's, wavering, all this, cited, by me
of righteousness, to speak, to you
